feature_name: Dopamine Depot layout and link cleanup
scope_summary: Removes identity-based merch filtering from Dopamine Depot, removes the 'Autistic Community' store section label, changes product language from 'pick your merch' to mockup/status language, improves contrast for design images, removes direct Printful purchase links that were causing 404s, and adds a simple coming-next section for future formats. No new data collection, checkout flow, tracking, scripts, or clinical claims are introduced.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: The update reduces risk by removing broken external purchase links and avoiding identity-based merch segmentation. It does not add regulated claims, checkout, payment collection, or professional advice.
evidence: Dopamine Depot now marks checkout links as pending instead of linking to potentially invalid Printful URLs
No purchase flow or payment processing added

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: Static front-end copy and markup only. No data capture, tracking, analytics, forms, storage, or new third-party scripts are added.
evidence: No new JavaScript dependency or analytics script
No form fields added

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: The page still uses neurodivergent context as brand language, but avoids diagnosis-specific merchandising categories and makes no treatment, cure, diagnostic, prevention, or clinical benefit claims.
evidence: Removed 'Autistic Community' category label
No new medical promises or therapeutic claims

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: The update reduces cognitive friction by removing unnecessary category decisions and replacing broken buy CTAs with honest status language. No urgency, scarcity, pressure, or dark-pattern mechanic is used.
evidence: No countdowns, limited-time prompts, or forced checkout path
Single collection grid replaces identity-based filters

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: The change avoids singling out autistic users as a public merch aisle and improves low-stimulus visual access with stronger image-background contrast. This better supports dignity, clarity, and sensory readability.
evidence: Identity category filter removed
Design images now sit on a warm light background with contain-fit instead of blending into dark surfaces

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: User benefit is a clearer, less embarrassing store experience with fewer dead ends. Harm is reduced by disabling broken outbound purchase links until verified.
evidence: Broken external Printful CTAs replaced with 'Link pending' status
Store copy explains checkout is paused while links are verified

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: Copy restores Dopamine Depot personality while avoiding humiliating or overly diagnostic labeling. Tone remains blunt and funny without making identity the category structure.
evidence: New copy: 'No identity-based aisles. No awkward labels. Just the collection.'
New copy: 'No glittery diagnostic billboards.'

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: The update uses semantic headings, standard buttons, keyboard-openable cards, modal escape handling, alt text, and improved visual contrast for design previews.
evidence: Cards retain tabindex and keyboard activation
Image previews use light contrast background and object-fit: contain
Modal retains aria-modal and labelled title

security_and_reliability.rationale: Removing unverified external links reduces broken navigation risk. No new dependencies, secrets, network calls, or runtime integrations are added.
evidence: No new external scripts
Direct Printful product links removed until verified

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: The page becomes less commercially aggressive by pausing checkout CTAs until links are verified. It does not add scarcity, urgency, upsell, subscription, or payment pressure.
evidence: Checkout buttons replaced by disabled 'Link pending' labels
Future formats described as coming next, not sold as currently available

ship_decision.conditions: All pillars pass. Change is static, reduces broken-link risk, removes identity-based merchandising, and keeps checkout paused until product links are verified.
